## Setup

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
rm(list = ls())

library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
here()
demand <- read.csv("Data/Processed/CleanDemand_v1.csv") %>%
  select(-X) %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

temp <- read.csv("Data/Processed/CleanTemp_v1.csv") %>%
  select(-X) %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

humidity <- read.csv("Data/Processed/CleanHumidity_v1.csv") %>%
  select(-X) %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(date))

data_full <- demand %>%
  left_join(temp, by = "date") %>%
  left_join(humidity, by = "date")

nobs <- nrow(data_full)
```

## Create Clean Time Series Objects

```{r}
# Handle NAs
demand_clean <- na.interp(data_full$avg_load, linear = TRUE)
demand_msts <- msts(demand_clean,
                    seasonal.periods = c(7, 365.25),
                    start = c(2005, 1))

weather_xreg <- cbind(temp = data_full$avg_temp,
                      humid = data_full$avg_humidity)
```

## Training / Validation Split

```{r}
n_for <- 365

train_load <- data_full$avg_load[1:(nobs - n_for)]
train_load_clean <- na.interp(train_load, linear = TRUE)
demand_train <- msts(train_load_clean,
                     seasonal.periods = c(7, 365.25),
                     start = c(2005, 1))

test_load <- data_full$avg_load[(nobs - n_for + 1):nobs]
test_load_clean <- na.interp(test_load, linear = TRUE)
demand_test <- msts(test_load_clean,
                    seasonal.periods = c(7, 365.25),
                    start = c(2010, 182))

weather_train <- weather_xreg[1:(nobs - n_for), ]
weather_test <- weather_xreg[(nobs - n_for + 1):nobs, ]
weather_july2010 <- weather_test[1:31, ]
observed_july2010 <- data_full$avg_load[(nobs - n_for + 1):(nobs - n_for + 31)]
```

## Fit Individual Models for Ensemble

```{r}
cat("Fitting individual models...\n\n")

# Model 1: TBATS
cat("1. TBATS...\n")
TBATS_fit <- tbats(demand_train)
TBATS_for <- forecast(TBATS_fit, h = 31)

# Model 2: ARIMA+Fourier+Weather (K=2,4)
cat("2. ARIMA+Fourier+Weather (K=2,4)...\n")
ARIMA_24_fit <- auto.arima(demand_train,
                           seasonal = FALSE,
                           lambda = 0,
                           xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = c(2, 4)),
                                       weather_train))
ARIMA_24_for <- forecast(ARIMA_24_fit,
                         h = 31,
                         xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = c(2, 4), h = 31),
                                     weather_july2010))

# Model 3: ARIMA+Fourier+Weather (K=3,6)
cat("3. ARIMA+Fourier+Weather (K=3,6)...\n")
ARIMA_36_fit <- auto.arima(demand_train,
                           seasonal = FALSE,
                           lambda = 0,
                           xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = c(3, 6)),
                                       weather_train))
ARIMA_36_for <- forecast(ARIMA_36_fit,
                         h = 31,
                         xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = c(3, 6), h = 31),
                                     weather_july2010))

# Model 4: ARIMA+Fourier NO weather (K=2,6)
cat("4. ARIMA+Fourier NO weather (K=2,6)...\n")
ARIMA_26_noweather_fit <- auto.arima(demand_train,
                                     seasonal = FALSE,
                                     lambda = 0,
                                     xreg = fourier(demand_train, K = c(2, 6)))
ARIMA_26_noweather_for <- forecast(ARIMA_26_noweather_fit,
                                   h = 31,
                                   xreg = fourier(demand_train, K = c(2, 6), h = 31))

# Model 5: Neural Network
cat("5. Neural Network...\n")
NN_fit <- nnetar(demand_train,
                p = 1,
                P = 0,
                xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = c(2, 4)),
                            weather_train))
NN_for <- forecast(NN_fit,
                  h = 31,
                  xreg = cbind(fourier(demand_train, K = c(2, 4), h = 31),
                              weather_july2010))

cat("\nAll models fitted!\n")
```

## Individual Model Performance

```{r}
# Calculate accuracy for each model
acc_TBATS <- accuracy(TBATS_for$mean, observed_july2010)
acc_ARIMA24 <- accuracy(ARIMA_24_for$mean, observed_july2010)
acc_ARIMA36 <- accuracy(ARIMA_36_for$mean, observed_july2010)
acc_ARIMA26_nw <- accuracy(ARIMA_26_noweather_for$mean, observed_july2010)
acc_NN <- accuracy(NN_for$mean, observed_july2010)

individual_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c("TBATS", "ARIMA+Weather K(2,4)", "ARIMA+Weather K(3,6)", 
            "ARIMA No Weather K(2,6)", "Neural Network"),
  RMSE = c(acc_TBATS[2], acc_ARIMA24[2], acc_ARIMA36[2], acc_ARIMA26_nw[2], acc_NN[2]),
  MAE = c(acc_TBATS[3], acc_ARIMA24[3], acc_ARIMA36[3], acc_ARIMA26_nw[3], acc_NN[3]),
  MAPE = c(acc_TBATS[5], acc_ARIMA24[5], acc_ARIMA36[5], acc_ARIMA26_nw[5], acc_NN[5])
)

kbl(individual_results,
    caption = "Individual Model Performance - July 2010 Validation",
    digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                latex_options = "hold_position")
```

## Create Ensemble Forecasts

```{r}
cat("\n=== CREATING ENSEMBLES ===\n\n")

# Ensemble 1: Simple Average (all 5 models)
ensemble_simple <- (TBATS_for$mean + ARIMA_24_for$mean + ARIMA_36_for$mean + 
                   ARIMA_26_noweather_for$mean + NN_for$mean) / 5

# Ensemble 2: Weighted by inverse RMSE (better models get more weight)
w_tbats <- 1/acc_TBATS[2]
w_arima24 <- 1/acc_ARIMA24[2]
w_arima36 <- 1/acc_ARIMA36[2]
w_arima26 <- 1/acc_ARIMA26_nw[2]
w_nn <- 1/acc_NN[2]
total_w <- w_tbats + w_arima24 + w_arima36 + w_arima26 + w_nn

ensemble_weighted <- (TBATS_for$mean * w_tbats/total_w +
                     ARIMA_24_for$mean * w_arima24/total_w +
                     ARIMA_36_for$mean * w_arima36/total_w +
                     ARIMA_26_noweather_for$mean * w_arima26/total_w +
                     NN_for$mean * w_nn/total_w)

# Ensemble 3: Top 3 only (exclude worst 2)
rmse_values <- c(acc_TBATS[2], acc_ARIMA24[2], acc_ARIMA36[2], acc_ARIMA26_nw[2], acc_NN[2])
top3_idx <- order(rmse_values)[1:3]

forecasts_list <- list(TBATS_for$mean, ARIMA_24_for$mean, ARIMA_36_for$mean, 
                      ARIMA_26_noweather_for$mean, NN_for$mean)
ensemble_top3 <- (forecasts_list[[top3_idx[1]]] + 
                 forecasts_list[[top3_idx[2]]] + 
                 forecasts_list[[top3_idx[3]]]) / 3

# Ensemble 4: ARIMA models only (exclude TBATS and NN)
ensemble_arima_only <- (ARIMA_24_for$mean + ARIMA_36_for$mean + 
                       ARIMA_26_noweather_for$mean) / 3

# Ensemble 5: Best 2 (lowest RMSE models)
top2_idx <- order(rmse_values)[1:2]
ensemble_best2 <- (forecasts_list[[top2_idx[1]]] + forecasts_list[[top2_idx[2]]]) / 2

cat("Ensembles created!\n")
```

## Ensemble Performance

```{r}
# Calculate accuracy for ensembles
acc_simple <- accuracy(ensemble_simple, observed_july2010)
acc_weighted <- accuracy(ensemble_weighted, observed_july2010)
acc_top3 <- accuracy(ensemble_top3, observed_july2010)
acc_arima <- accuracy(ensemble_arima_only, observed_july2010)
acc_best2 <- accuracy(ensemble_best2, observed_july2010)

ensemble_results <- data.frame(
  Ensemble = c("Simple Average (All 5)", "Weighted by RMSE", "Top 3 Models",
              "ARIMA Only", "Best 2 Models"),
  RMSE = c(acc_simple[2], acc_weighted[2], acc_top3[2], acc_arima[2], acc_best2[2]),
  MAE = c(acc_simple[3], acc_weighted[3], acc_top3[3], acc_arima[3], acc_best2[3]),
  MAPE = c(acc_simple[5], acc_weighted[5], acc_top3[5], acc_arima[5], acc_best2[5])
)

ensemble_results <- ensemble_results %>%
  arrange(RMSE) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number())

kbl(ensemble_results,
    caption = "Ensemble Model Performance - July 2010 Validation",
    digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                latex_options = "hold_position") %>%
  row_spec(1, bold = TRUE, background = "#90EE90")
```

## Combined Results Table

```{r}
# Combine individual and ensemble results
combined_results <- bind_rows(
  individual_results %>% mutate(Type = "Individual"),
  ensemble_results %>% select(-Rank) %>% rename(Model = Ensemble) %>% mutate(Type = "Ensemble")
) %>%
  arrange(RMSE) %>%
  mutate(Rank = row_number())

kbl(combined_results,
    caption = "All Models Ranked by RMSE",
    digits = 4) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center",
                latex_options = "hold_position") %>%
  row_spec(which(combined_results$Rank == 1), bold = TRUE, background = "#FFD700")
```

## Generate Final Forecasts for Best Ensembles

```{r}
cat("\n=== GENERATING KAGGLE SUBMISSIONS FOR TOP 3 ENSEMBLES ===\n\n")

# Get top 3 ensemble methods
top_ensembles <- ensemble_results %>% arrange(RMSE) %>% slice(1:3)

# Retrain all models on full data
cat("Retraining all models on full dataset...\n")

TBATS_final <- tbats(demand_msts)
TBATS_final_for <- forecast(TBATS_final, h = 31)

july2010_weather <- weather_xreg[(nobs - n_for + 1):(nobs - n_for + 31), ]

ARIMA_24_final <- auto.arima(demand_msts, seasonal=FALSE, lambda=0,
                             xreg=cbind(fourier(demand_msts, K=c(2,4)), weather_xreg))
ARIMA_24_final_for <- forecast(ARIMA_24_final, h=31,
                               xreg=cbind(fourier(demand_msts, K=c(2,4), h=31),
                                         july2010_weather))

ARIMA_36_final <- auto.arima(demand_msts, seasonal=FALSE, lambda=0,
                             xreg=cbind(fourier(demand_msts, K=c(3,6)), weather_xreg))
ARIMA_36_final_for <- forecast(ARIMA_36_final, h=31,
                               xreg=cbind(fourier(demand_msts, K=c(3,6), h=31),
                                         july2010_weather))

ARIMA_26_nw_final <- auto.arima(demand_msts, seasonal=FALSE, lambda=0,
                                xreg=fourier(demand_msts, K=c(2,6)))
ARIMA_26_nw_final_for <- forecast(ARIMA_26_nw_final, h=31,
                                  xreg=fourier(demand_msts, K=c(2,6), h=31))

NN_final <- nnetar(demand_msts, p=1, P=0,
                  xreg=cbind(fourier(demand_msts, K=c(2,4)), weather_xreg))
NN_final_for <- forecast(NN_final, h=31,
                        xreg=cbind(fourier(demand_msts, K=c(2,4), h=31),
                                  july2010_weather))

# Create ensembles for July 2011
ensemble_simple_final <- (TBATS_final_for$mean + ARIMA_24_final_for$mean + 
                         ARIMA_36_final_for$mean + ARIMA_26_nw_final_for$mean + 
                         NN_final_for$mean) / 5

ensemble_weighted_final <- (TBATS_final_for$mean * w_tbats/total_w +
                           ARIMA_24_final_for$mean * w_arima24/total_w +
                           ARIMA_36_final_for$mean * w_arima36/total_w +
                           ARIMA_26_nw_final_for$mean * w_arima26/total_w +
                           NN_final_for$mean * w_nn/total_w)

forecasts_final_list <- list(TBATS_final_for$mean, ARIMA_24_final_for$mean, 
                            ARIMA_36_final_for$mean, ARIMA_26_nw_final_for$mean, 
                            NN_final_for$mean)

ensemble_top3_final <- (forecasts_final_list[[top3_idx[1]]] + 
                       forecasts_final_list[[top3_idx[2]]] + 
                       forecasts_final_list[[top3_idx[3]]]) / 3

ensemble_arima_final <- (ARIMA_24_final_for$mean + ARIMA_36_final_for$mean + 
                        ARIMA_26_nw_final_for$mean) / 3

ensemble_best2_final <- (forecasts_final_list[[top2_idx[1]]] + 
                        forecasts_final_list[[top2_idx[2]]]) / 2

# Save ensemble forecasts
july2011_dates <- seq(as.Date("2011-07-01"), as.Date("2011-07-31"), by = "day")

ensemble_list <- list(
  list(name = "simple", forecast = ensemble_simple_final),
  list(name = "weighted", forecast = ensemble_weighted_final),
  list(name = "top3", forecast = ensemble_top3_final),
  list(name = "arima_only", forecast = ensemble_arima_final),
  list(name = "best2", forecast = ensemble_best2_final)
)

for(ens in ensemble_list) {
  submission <- data.frame(
    date = july2011_dates,
    load = as.numeric(ens$forecast)
  )
  
  filename <- paste0("Submissions/ensemble_models/gilman_salzberg_ensemble_", ens$name, ".csv")
  write.csv(submission, file = filename, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Saved:", filename, "\n")
}

cat("\n=== COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Generated 5 ensemble submission files\n")
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== ENSEMBLE STRATEGY SUMMARY ===\n\n")

cat("Validation RMSE:", round(ensemble_results$RMSE[1], 2), "\n")
```
